description: Declarative mode registry: the single source of truth for the discriminator (workflowMode, packetKind, backendKind) and the advisorRouting projection for mcp-browser-use. The hub reads this file to resolve a mode. The advisor routes the single identity mcp-browser-use and the hub picks the mode. Every mode routes by hub membership (routingClass metadata), so no mode carries an advisor map entry.

discriminator.workflowMode: Public hub and mode key. Stable identity used by the hub router and this registry. Carried by every mode.
discriminator.packetKind: The axis discriminator. Every mode in this hub is a workflow packet, because each one can change local state through its own tool surface.
discriminator.backendKind: Which backend runs the mode. Every mode in this hub uses cli-plus-mcp: a CLI for the fast path and Code Mode MCP for multi-tool integration.

advisorRoutingContract.routingClass: How the advisor finds the mode. Every mode here is metadata, which means resolved by hub membership. The advisor routes the single identity mcp-browser-use and the hub picks the mode, so no mode carries an advisor map entry or a merged-identity projection.
advisorRoutingContract.packetSkillName: The packet SKILL.md name. For mcp-browser-use the packet folder is its packetSkillName for every mode, so no mode has a folder and name mismatch.
advisorRoutingContract.grandfatheredFolderMismatch: True only when a packet folder differs from its packetSkillName on purpose. Every mode here uses folder equal to packetSkillName, so the flag is false throughout.
advisorRoutingContract.command: The bound slash command for the mode. No mode has a dedicated command, so command is null on every entry.
